fields.statement: QA cycle 5, scratch binary go build -trimpath -o $TMPDIR/qa5/rhiza ./cmd/rhiza, scratch autonomous plan run (rhiza run start --workflow plan --autonomous, fake agents from plan-workflow-autonomous-unapplied.txtar with a reviser paused at apply-rulings): run round 3 left two arbitrated questions, one on serving-draft leaf export-csv and one on landed decision keep-flat. From the reviser's environment (RHIZA_CHANGE = the run's change set), following rhiza guide plan-reviser 'Applying the arbiter's rulings' literally: rhiza run status --json gave the serving-draft question change=<draft> and the other none; rhiza show <decision> --change <it> exit 0 for both (bare rhiza show exit 4, as the guide now avoids); rhiza apply set export-csv --change <draft> and keep-flat --record exit 0; decided-by links via rhiza apply --change <it> exit 0; rhiza run review-check --rulings passed 2 rulings applied; the run then went rulings visit 2 pass, gate, open-pr, merge, succeeded. Scoped tests: internal/api TestRunInfoAcceptsAndQuestions|TestRunReviewCheckRulings, internal/guide TestPlanReviserText, cmd/rhiza describe-golden, plan-workflow-autonomous-left, plan-workflow-autonomous-unapplied all ok.
